summary.name: CVExpert
summary.one_liner: CVExpert is a paid AI-plus-human job search service that provides career coaching, a rewritten CV, daily tailored job shortlists, application submission with approval, and introductions to hiring managers.
use_cases: Getting a rewritten CV for a job search
Receiving daily job shortlists by email
Tailoring CVs and cover letters to specific roles
Finding referrers and hiring managers at target companies
Finding mentors to guide a career move
summary.what_it_does: CVExpert pairs a human career coach with an AI agent to help define a job search goal, including role, salary, and type of work. The AI agent searches for roles matching the user's goals and preferences and emails a daily shortlist. CVExpert writes a new CV, tailors the CV and cover letter to each role, and submits applications only after the user approves them. It also identifies hiring managers and potential referrers at target companies and helps write introduction messages, which the user reviews before sending.
notable: Human career coach plus AI agent with user approval before any application is submitted
Daily personalised job shortlists by email
Success fee of one month's gross base salary, paid over 12 instalments, only if a job is landed through CVExpert
caveats: $100 USD per month plus a success fee on landing a job (one month's gross base salary, excluding bonuses, commission, and equity)
Success fee applies only to jobs sourced and supported through CVExpert
